## Context

- Audit 17 found that check_record checks section presence only: the probe test runs only if the section is truthy, the task-force loop has no members to flag when the list is empty, the domain-expert boundary list comes from the self-reported cycles field, members are not checked for domain or context, why or assignee, and the retro needs flow_metrics and practice_metrics only as truthy values.
- Each loophole gets its own red test first (D137), the full set recorded in mob-defaults with a reference to D145 and D136; the subject cites MD-003 so it is a corrective commit.
- Left to other cards: 209 (the no-removal rule, MD-001) and 211 (the independent review, MD-010). This card does not change how seats are staffed or how probes are taken.
